scripts.validate: bun run check && bun run lint && bun run cli openapi:validate && bun run test:all
scripts.validate:ci: bun run check && bun run lint:ci && bun run check:module-imports && bun run verify:versions && bun run parity:audit && bun run build:framework && bun run build:bootstrap && bun run build:cli && bun run verify:framework && bun run verify:bootstrap && bun run verify:starter && bun run verify:cli && DOGFOOD_APP=hiroapp APP_KEY_PREFIX=hiroapp APP_NAME=HiroApp API_PREFIX=/api bun run cli openapi:validate && DOGFOOD_APP=hiroapp APP_KEY_PREFIX=hiroapp APP_NAME=HiroApp API_PREFIX=/api bun run cli openapi:check && bun run test:coverage && bun run test:hiroapp:coverage
scripts.verify:framework: bun run build:framework && bun scripts/verify-core-shared-subpaths.ts && bun scripts/verify-bundled-subpaths.ts && bun scripts/verify-no-root-imports.ts && bun scripts/verify-no-shared-barrel-imports.ts && bun scripts/verify-export-types.ts && bun -e "import('./packages/strata-core/dist/index.js').then((m) => { if (typeof m.BaseRepository !== 'function') throw new Error('missing BaseRepository export'); })"
scripts.verify:bootstrap: bun run build:bootstrap && bun -e "import('./packages/strata-bootstrap/dist/index.js').then((m) => { if (typeof m.createWebServer !== 'function') throw new Error('missing createWebServer export'); })"
scripts.verify:cli: bun run build:cli && bun packages/strata-cli/cli.ts help
scripts.validate:host: scripts/with-host-env.sh sh -c 'bun run build:framework && bun run build:bootstrap && DOGFOOD_APP=workhub bun run cli migrate:fresh --seed && DOGFOOD_APP=hiroapp bun run cli migrate:fresh --seed && WORKHUB_SKIP_TEST_BOOTSTRAP=1 bun run validate:ci'
scripts.test:host: scripts/with-host-env.sh sh -c 'bun run build:framework && bun run build:bootstrap && DOGFOOD_APP=workhub bun run cli migrate:fresh --seed && DOGFOOD_APP=hiroapp bun run cli migrate:fresh --seed && WORKHUB_SKIP_TEST_BOOTSTRAP=1 QUEUE_DRIVER=sync bun run test:coverage'
scripts.build:frontend: cd frontend && bun install --frozen-lockfile && bun run build
scripts.test:all: QUEUE_DRIVER=sync bun run unit && QUEUE_DRIVER=sync bun run integration
scripts.test:hiroapp: HIROAPP_TEST=1 DOGFOOD_APP=hiroapp QUEUE_DRIVER=sync MAIL_DRIVER=log CACHE_DRIVER=array FRONTEND_MODE=server-htmx HIROAPP_SEED_SCALE=demo bun test --preload ./apps/hiroapp/src/tests/preload.ts ./apps/hiroapp/src/tests
